paragraphs.text: This is news of the unseen that the Prophet did not know before. So be patient; the best end is for the righteous.

Allah sent Hud to 'Aad. He told them to worship Allah alone. He asked for no reward. He told them to ask forgiveness and repent, and Allah would send rain and more strength. They said, "You brought no clear proof. We will not leave our gods." Hud said he was free of their partners. He relied on Allah, who holds every creature by its forelock. Allah saved Hud and the believers. 'Aad rejected His signs and followed every stubborn tyrant. A curse followed them.

Allah sent Salih to Thamud. He said Allah made them from the earth and settled them in it. His Lord is near and answers. They said, "We had hopes in you before. Do you forbid what our fathers worshipped?" Salih showed them the she-camel of Allah as a sign. But they harmed her. So he said, "Enjoy your homes for three days."

hardWords.m: the hair at the front of the head
